text: I found the memoir 'Bridges Between Us' deeply moving, particularly because the author’s willingness to confront her own flaws made the narrative feel authentic and relatable. It is compelling to see how vulnerability can serve as a bridge to forgiveness, reminding us that maintaining family bonds requires significant effort and empathy. On a sensory note, the taste of sugar is a straightforward, immediate sweetness that coats the tongue, offering a quick burst of pleasure without complexity, which stands in stark contrast to the nuanced emotional flavors found in the book.
